E0602

`use` path escapes the project (`..` or outside entry tree)

What

`use` path escapes the project (`..` or outside entry tree)

Why

The registered jet rule applies here

Fix

Keep the `use` path inside the project entry tree.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0602: tests/ui/import_escape/stderr.

Error [jet.UsePathEscapesProject]: This import path escapes the package
  --> tests/ui/import_escape/run.jet:1:5
    |
  1 | use "../outside"
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Inside a package, file imports stay in the package tree — `..` works only for loose files outside any package
 Fix: Use a path without `..`, or move the file inside the package tree
